brand_facts: Stumps are ground at least 6 inches deep
Raised roots can be removed as part of the job
Cleanup is an optional add-on — you only pay for what you need
$200 minimum fee applies to all stump grinding work
Serving 18 eastern Iowa counties: Allamakee, Clayton, Dubuque, Jackson, Jones, Linn, Cedar, Johnson, Benton, Tama, Delaware, Buchanan, Black Hawk, Grundy, Fayette, Bremer, Winneshiek, Chickasaw
Quotes are usually same-day, with no obligation
Landscape restoration is offered — backfilling the hole with topsoil after grinding
There is an online cost calculator at /StumpGrinding/IowaCostCalculator/
